text:
alex: ran the large sweep across A100/H100/L40S for the week — KV prefetch policy changes show a weird regression on L40S at seq=4096, bsz=1. dashboard: https://perf.local/runs/28198 :eyes:

sara: wow, regression how bad?

alex: ~2.2x latency increase on L40S 4096/1 vs baseline (no-prefetch). A100/H100 fine. numbers in CSV attached in the run.

jun: is this with fused-paged flash or plain paged-flash?

alex: fused-paged flash variant + KV_PREFETCH=aggressive. baseline was fused-paged + KV_PREFETCH=off. we tried flash-alt kernels too, same pattern.

perf-bot: test-matrix: [A100,H100,L40S] x seq=[512,1024,2048,4096] x bsz=[1,2,4] x kernels=[fused-paged, paged, flash-variant] x prefetch=[off, adaptive, aggressive]

mike: can you paste the perf trace (small)?

alex: pasted snippet:
```
# trace snippet (top hotspots)
L40S: memcpy_htod 35%
L40S: page_fault_handler 22%
kernel: fused_paged_attention 18%
kv_prefetch_worker 12%
spin_wait 7%
```

alex: looks like prefetch workers keep touching pages and causing H2D churn on L40S PCI path + driver heuristics. A100/H100 have a different DMA pattern so not affected.

tara: did we try lowering prefetch window or switching to adaptive?

alex: yes, adaptive reduces it back to baseline at seq 4096/1 but increases variability for mixed-batch workloads. tradeoff table in the run.

jun: interesting — could be our page size alignment or scatter-gather causing more thrash on that particular L40S driver. Can we repro with a smaller mem-pressure reproduce?

alex: repro script I used:
```
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export KV_PREFETCH=aggressive
python perf/run_attention_sweep.py --gpu l40s --seqs 512 1024 2048 4096 --bsz 1 2 4 --kernel fused-paged --iters 200
```

mike: try adding MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_=0 and set hugepages off to see if kernel page fragmentation is amplifying this.

alex: will try. also running kernel bisect: toggle fused-paged micro-kernel version (v1/v2) — early results show v2 less bad but still 1.6x.

perf-bot: NOTE: creating perf-issue #428 for L40S-kv-prefetch with attached traces. tagging eng-runtime, eng-infra.

tara: action items: (1) alex run MALLOC tweak + prefetch-window=small and post numbers; (2) mike help with driver DMA flags and hugepage test; (3) jun run micro-kernel v2-only sweep on L40S. update thread when you have numbers. :thumbsup:

alex: starting MALLOC tweak now, will post quick table in <30m. thanks all.

sara: thanks — also adding a note to the rollout doc to avoid enabling aggressive prefetch for L40S until this is resolved.
